title: Mortification by the Spirit
definition: Mortification by the Spirit is the Spirit-enabled putting to death of sinful desires, habits, and deeds.
summary: The Spirit empowers believers to put sin to death and walk in holiness.
christFocus: Jesus broke sin's dominion, and by the Spirit His people fight sin from a place of grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Mortification means putting sin to death. This is not self-hatred or legalistic striving; it is Spirit-empowered repentance and obedience.

Believers are responsible to fight sin, but they cannot do it by the flesh. The Spirit gives power to say no to sinful desires and yes to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Sin often grows stronger when it is hidden, excused, or managed instead of put to death. This doctrine matters because believers are called to real holiness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Name specific sin and bring it to God. Use Scripture, prayer, accountability, and practical obedience as you depend on the Spirit to put it to death.
